evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen to 14.2 ppm from 28764 ppm at 120 s.
Growth transition shows a transient temperature overshoot to 760.2 °C with heater power reduced to 39.6%.
Temperature settled to 750.4 °C against 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 41.3%.
Argon 99.9 sccm matches 100 sccm setpoint; pressure 3.063 Torr and oxygen 4.3 ppm remain consistent with stable growth conditions; controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Post-run sample characterization is required to determine whether the target material grew.
